result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, I'd recommend **Linear** as the best overall project management tool, particularly if you're building a tech product or SaaS business.

However, the best choice depends on your startup's stage, team size, and whether you're managing software development, marketing, operations, or the entire business.

Here are the tools I'd shortlist.

## Best project management tools for startups

![Projects – Linear Docs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/H7btCzSbelKXdMr_2WS3GWddG9qajBq9JZDHM8HYyOoLV6E4HDh5vlzogddffE6t5gTnGdoZ53UsXuMyPZWPmHRUwQ3ddApfS44CKAri923rLMIeylRQs9HZxmyB23G0rTfX3tmbKwJPdUtZW_x9bJsI8X8b5_Xrbg_k3vvdE22XkcL7igbp9gCGi9QLirCv?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent for product roadmaps, development sprints and bug tracking.
- Clean, fast interface.
- Great for teams working with GitHub.
- Less suitable for managing every business function.

Free plan available; paid plans from around \$10/user/month.

[Visit Linear](https://linear.app/)

---

![Finastra Customer Story | ClickUp™](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/OXxUksa73j7hoTxbYQ6zo3pspX36GflPBLMsRWXjhfWZTJdFq6md_tXaxCCc_3Kjh0xQSrUSgXoCYi3d5TOe48r-mvzFwLplQbgf4lhsH3q_bsATt_hAcyva5qI1DtZG8OasgRxxldReZAIfURcJdNdt2Br8nPVvqn-lCO5aR2MxpFl9QAiCxibf4gzehOOb?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. ClickUp**

(Best all-rounder)

- Tasks, projects, documents and goals.
- Dashboards and workload management.
- Suitable for marketing, operations, sales and product teams.
- Can become complicated if over-customised.

Free plan available; paid plans from around \$7/user/month.

[Visit ClickUp](https://clickup.com/)

---

![Projects & Tasks Template by Notion | Notion Marketplace](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/yqXS2tBYYgklcz7vMhTTs4bLbvL88Cgi4WoUElrVJ5Ge7XTkOSgH-nuQji_OGnf8zWep9eOojCOQh5DYOROLY-F6UHVJa4vD9y9Gw17JhHC7tidutG-zxz3QXJjQVsnaYpKpPYmxZIPnjIweR9b7UOV1D2uLBf_LEDZlwhs7mXltRyaeNFILrJPVDr6f7980?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Notion**

(Best for early-stage startups)

- Combines documentation, wikis, tasks and planning.
- Excellent for company knowledge and processes.
- Flexible enough to build your own workspace.
- Less powerful for complex project tracking.

Free plan available; paid plans from around \$10/user/month.

[Visit Notion](https://www.notion.com/)

---

![Introducing Dashboards - a new way to see real-time project data in charts! - Product Launches - Asana Forum](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/wCWLFp4dMEl_v-oRmbowsFC6S4_evWBQMtRxSSXp7OXP6wtqD-ndySpIhbE0vKytZ9TUoZukBYXzktu332gBeqtOvFB5r_4mn9l1GOAEawsVNLrfaNRXIZhTP4IIa9xyWd0YUcL0lL-4dUI7q2c9LjUAelrs03KqyhIOzNbo8gDFWwNUhH6KJIHf5z_4WbFK?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Asana**

- Great for coordinating multiple departments.
- Clear task ownership and deadlines.
- Strong project timelines and dependencies.
- Can become expensive as the team grows.

Free plan available; paid plans from around \$10.99/user/month.

[Visit Asana](https://asana.com/)

---

![Monday Vibe | Build Custom Apps with Vibe Coding & AI Prompts](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/dZbPOy2ExCYPWkRUN-y8aNBArPHAy5RJyF2Fv3kOH8r0onm7GzQMtNgFLnlF_orijMr1L_hlS3rZ5CmII7wcg1sC5QIg6R8JlCgddpaNU2x9UGq4FrFp6DOJXu4JvN0TyREqPyEMky1tg6L3RhInST4tHJiMa0BGxgH61Ibvrnb8NABR1soD10zbitKXa9pg?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Monday.com**

- Excellent visual dashboards.
- Custom workflows and automations.
- Good for operations-heavy businesses.
- More structure than some very early startups need.

Free plan available; paid plans from around \$9/seat/month.

[Visit Monday.com](https://monday.com/)

Pricing is indicative, generally based on annual billing, and may vary by region and plan. Sources: [www.techrepublic.com](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/project-management-software-for-startups/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[hackceleration.com](https://hackceleration.com/labs/best/startup-project-management-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[thedigitalprojectmanager.com](https://thedigitalprojectmanager.com/tools/best-project-management-software-for-startups/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down like this\:

| Your startup situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| SaaS / tech startup | Linear |
| General startup, multiple departments | ClickUp |
| Pre-seed, tiny founding team | Notion |
| Growing team with lots of projects | Asana |
| Operations and process-heavy business | Monday.com |


One combination I particularly like is **Linear + Notion**\: Linear manages execution, while Notion holds company documentation, strategy, meeting notes and processes.

## Let me narrow it down for your startup
